use.flag: Build the GTK 4 GUI using gui-libs/gtk:4 instead of the default GTK+ 3 one. The GTK 4 GUI uses no X11 API, so 'session' (X session management) is unavailable with it.
Include netbeans external editor integration support

Render |:hardcopy| output with x11-libs/pango and x11-libs/cairo rather than Vim's own PostScript generator. Gains full Unicode support and PDF output, at the cost of the 'printencoding', 'printmbcharset' and 'printmbfont' options, which exist only for the built-in generator.
Enable support for Scheme using dev-scheme/racket
